hints.title: Composite Box and Player Positioning
hints.text: The state space consists of the current box coordinates paired with the current player coordinates on the grid.

hints.title: Player Reachability Pre-check
hints.text: For the player to push the box in direction D, the player must be able to reach the cell opposite to direction D without passing through the box.

hints.title: Nested Breadth Search Formulation
hints.text: Use 0-1 BFS or Dijkstra on state (box_r, box_c, player_r, player_c) where box moves cost 1 push and player repositioning costs 0.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Total states is bounded by (R * C) box positions times 4 adjacent player positions, each verified with BFS in O(R * C) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simple shortest path ignores the physical constraint that player must navigate around obstacles and the box to execute pushes.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoizing reachable player components prevents redundant flood-fill sub-searches.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Nested breadth-first search separating push transitions from player transit reachability.
